measures.name: Specific Energy Consumption
measures.formula: Total energy consumed (GJ) / total crude steel produced (t)

measures.name: Energy Cost Avoidance
measures.formula: Sum of baseline-schedule cost minus as-run cost over accepted recommendations

measures.name: Specific CO2 Emissions
measures.daxMeasure: KPI-CO2-01 Specific CO2 t per t
measures.formula: Total CO2e emitted (t) / total crude steel produced (t)

measures.name: ETS Allowance Cost Exposure
measures.formula: Forecast emissions above free allocation (t) * ETS allowance price (EUR/t)

measures.name: Lining Failure Lead Time
measures.formula: Actual reline/failure timestamp minus alert issue timestamp in days

measures.name: Unplanned Outage Avoidance
measures.formula: Count of unplanned furnace outages over rolling 12 months
measures.target: Downward trend; zero catastrophic unplanned events

measures.name: RUL Prediction Precision and Recall
measures.formula: Standard precision and recall for alerts vs failures within the evaluation window
measures.target: Precision at least 0.8 and recall at least 0.9 (illustrative)

measures.name: High-Grade Yield Rate
measures.formula: First-pass automotive-grade tonnes meeting spec / automotive-grade tonnes attempted

measures.name: Procedure Library Coverage
measures.formula: Critical topics with an approved procedure / identified critical topics

measures.name: Knowledge Retrieval Time
measures.formula: Median time from query to cited relevant answer
measures.target: Less than 10 seconds in the demo

measures.name: AI Recommendation Acceptance Rate
measures.formula: Accepted recommendations across all domains / recommendations issued

measures.name: Platform Adoption
measures.formula: Weekly active target users / licensed or target users
measures.target: At least 80% by end of pilot

measures.name: Audit Completeness
measures.formula: Recommendations with a complete audit record / recommendations issued
